title: scan_from = 0usize: redundant type suffix on integer literal
description: In client.rs, the SseStreamState initialization has 'scan_from: 0usize, // invariant...' The usize suffix is redundant: the field type is usize so the literal 0 is unambiguously typed. The inconsistency is visible because the reassignment later uses 'scan_from = 0;' without the suffix. Suggested rewrite: 'scan_from: 0,'
